17.message:
fix(installer): open version/branch menus instantly with a loading frame
 - the version + branch submenus fetched from GitHub before opening, so a click did nothing for a few seconds

18.message:
ci(publish): give the github-gradle build a token so dough resolves in the GitHub-only release

The publish built :core:shadowJar with no GH_TOKEN, so github-gradle's gh call to resolve Slimefun5/dough failed. Set GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN on the build step (PAT-or-default, same as the reusable ci.yaml).
18.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

19.message:
fix(storage): load H2/MySQL drivers at runtime instead of shading them

 - the shaded jar hit 10MB (H2 + MySQL driver + protobuf) and Hangar rejected it (413); the drivers are no longer bundled, bringing the jar back to ~3.3MB
 - StorageDriverLoader loads a JDBC driver from the classpath if present (unit tests), else downloads it once into plugins/Slimefun/libraries/ and loads it via a child URLClassLoader, connecting through the Driver instance directly (DriverManager can't see child-loaded drivers)
 - if a driver can't be obtained (offline first boot, bad config), storage falls back to legacy flat-files for that boot with a clear log instead of failing to enable
 - build: H2 is now testImplementation, MySQL dependency dropped, h2/mysql/protobuf relocations removed
19.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

20.message:
fix(guide): show translated item names, not canonicalized raw ids

 - WikiPage item-page title, AddonBalanceMenu tiles, GiveCommand messages read getItemName() at runtime, which returns the raw id after template canonicalization
 - route them through ItemTranslationService.getName(p, item) like the guide/WikiIndex
20.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

21.message:
fix(multiblock): stop false "Assembled" message on blocked placement

onMultiBlockComplete never checked BlockPlaceEvent#canBuild() and read world state inline before the placement settled or reverted, so a placement blocked by the player occupying the target cell still announced the machine as assembled. Now bail when !canBuild(), defer the structure match one tick via Slimefun.runSync and re-verify the placed block still exists before messaging, and build the name with the per-viewer ItemTranslationService.getName.
21.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

22.message:
fix(multiblock): dispatch interaction to all matching structures, not just the last

 - on 1.8-1.12 material-collapse makes distinct multiblocks (e.g. ARMOR_FORGE / EXP_DISPENSER -> ANVIL+DISPENSER) match the same clicked structure; getLast() silently routed to the wrong one
 - iterate all matches most-recent-first; each machine's onInteract self-guards
22.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

23.message:
fix(spawner): guard null lore for id-only items (NPE resolving spawner EntityType)

 - id-only items carry no physical lore under the packet-translation architecture; getEntityType/getItemForEntityType NPE'd on meta.getLore()
 - spawn type lives in BlockStateMeta; default lore to empty
23.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

24.message:
feat(guide): make main-menu categorization a per-player toggle in guide settings

 - new MainMenuLayoutOption (Categorized/Classic) in the Settings panel, stored per-player, defaulting to the server guide.categorize-main-menu value
 - getVisibleItemGroups reads the per-player choice
24.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

25.message:
fix(talisman): match BlockDropItemEvent by name, not instanceof (1.8 NoClassDefFoundError)

 - getPlayerByEventType ran 'instanceof BlockDropItemEvent' (1.13+) for EVERY routed event before the PlayerEvent branch, crashing every talisman trigger on 1.8-1.12
 - match by class name + reflective getPlayer() so the class is never referenced on legacy
25.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

26.message:
fix(autocraft): gate redstone craft on what the owner could craft by hand (online owner)

 - previously a strict hasUnlocked check blocked owners who can craft manually via creative/op bypass; now an online owner is gated via canPlayerUseItem (research + bypass), matching the manual craft; offline falls back to the loaded profile's hasUnlocked
 - log the reason when a matched recipe is skipped (backpack / not-allowed)
26.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

27.message:
fix(autocraft): deposit redstone output into an adjacent output chest, not just the ground

 - a successful redstone craft (crafted=true) dropped the item out the dispenser front even when an output chest was present, so it looked like nothing was made; now deposits into an OutputChest if one can hold it, ejecting only as fallback
 - log the crafted output + destination so a successful craft is visible
27.author: intisy (Finn Birich)
